title: Found the Anti-AI crowd making fun of my AI disclosure in Steam community discussions
author: njbmartin
selftext:
My very first game to launch on Steam last week gained over 10,000 wishlists just before launch, and now it’s launched it’s getting mixed reviews where the negative reviews are understandably calling out poorly written AI text.

But buried in the community hub are discussions from people who just want to hate on AI, one discussion leads with “lmao the disclosure reads like the fattest cope ever, what a loser. You deserve nothing”.

It doesn’t bother me because I chose to use Claude Code to help write the story and the narrative elements, and I chose to be honest and upfront in the AI disclosure.

I could have just said “AI was used during the development of the game”, but I opted to give a bit of background to explain why it wasn’t an “AI Slop” game. They’re welcome to their opinions, and they seem to be doing it in a place that nobody really reads, so I’ve chosen to just ignore it.

How are other people handling the AI disclosure and the anti-AI crowd?

replies.author: frigginwizard420
replies.body:
I don't agree    
I think disclosure costs less and less in terms of pushback every day, but getting caught lying will never stop being something that outrages the masses.

replies.author: Alarmed-Quail7617
replies.body: Sure buddy, enjoy the 10 sales you get for your ai tagged game, I'll be enjoyin the 1000s of sales and deal with "being caught lying" later.

replies.author: frigginwizard420
replies.body:
Oh?   
Can you link me to your game with thousands of downloads?

replies.author: Alarmed-Quail7617
replies.body:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5189160/We_March_as_One/ What's up?

What have you made? I doubt you'll link anything in return, much less anything that's made as much.

replies.author: frigginwizard420
replies.body:
The petty in me wants to screenshot this and out you, but I won't.  
I tried your demo a month ago or something, it was fun  
I only have something in early access, still a long way to go  
https://consumetheworld.itch.io/consume

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body:
Your post was automatically removed because it looks like it's mainly about anti-AI attitudes elsewhere, without discussing game development using AI. This sub is focused on game development using generative AI (Rule 1).

A mod will review this removal and can restore the post if it was a mistake. You don't need to do anything, but you can [message the mods](https://www.reddit.com/message/compose?to=/r/aigamedev) if you want to add context.

comments.body: In a few years, they'll be mopping data center floors while you're working on your tenth game.

comments.body: Steam should really only allow people who bought the game to review.
